no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Kaya Holdings is a vertically integrated cannabis cultivator/retailer (Oregon recreational and medical marijuana) with an early-stage psilocybin services business (Sacred Mushroom Ceremonies in Oregon). It does not develop drug product candidates and has no IND-stage assets, no IRB-registered Phase 1/2/3 clinical trials, and no FDA-regulated drug pipeline. The 10-K (FY2024, filed 2025-04-29) describes only commercial cannabis operations and a psilocybin services subsidiary; ClinicalTrials.gov returns zero trials sponsored by Kaya Holdings.
